# Playback

A video playing on a screen, from `screen:play`. Once it has ended its methods answer `nil` or `false`, except `video()` and `length()`; `exists()` says whether it has.

A handle: call its methods with a colon, `playback:method()`.


| | Methods |
| --- | --- |
| [What it is](#what-it-is) | [`video`](#video) [`screen`](#screen) [`length`](#length) [`exists`](#exists) |
| [Controls](#controls) | [`is_paused`](#is_paused) [`pause`](#pause) [`resume`](#resume) [`stop`](#stop) [`time`](#time) [`seek`](#seek) [`speed`](#speed) [`set_speed`](#set_speed) [`volume`](#volume) [`set_volume`](#set_volume) [`is_looping`](#is_looping) [`set_looping`](#set_looping) |
| [Events](#events) | [`on`](#on) [`once`](#once) and 2 events |

## What it is {#what-it-is}

### `playback:video()` {#video}

Which video it is: its folder name under `videos/`, even after it has ended.

**Returns** `string`

### `playback:screen()` {#screen}

The screen it plays on; `nil` once it has ended.

**Returns** [`Screen`](screen.md)`?`

### `playback:length()` {#length}

How long the video lasts, in seconds, even after it has ended.

**Returns** `number`

### `playback:exists()` {#exists}

Whether it hasn't ended: paused counts.

**Returns** `boolean`

## Controls {#controls}

### `playback:is_paused()` {#is_paused}

Whether it is paused.

**Returns** `boolean`

### `playback:pause()` {#pause}

Holds it on the frame it shows, its sound stopped.

**Returns** `boolean`: `false` when it was paused already, or has ended.

### `playback:resume()` {#resume}

Plays it on from where it was paused, its sound from there too.

**Returns** `boolean`: `false` when it wasn't paused, or has ended.

### `playback:stop()` {#stop}

Ends it now, with reason `"stopped"`. The screen keeps its last frame.

**Returns** `boolean`: `false` when it had already ended.

### `playback:time()` {#time}

Where it is, in seconds from the video's start; `nil` once it has ended.

**Returns** `number?`

### `playback:seek(seconds)` {#seek}

Jumps to a time in the video, in seconds (held to 0 and its length); its sound starts again from there.

| Parameter | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `seconds` | `number` | Where to. |

**Returns** `boolean`: `false` when it has ended.

### `playback:speed()` {#speed}

How fast it plays: 1 is as recorded. `nil` once it has ended.

**Returns** `number?`

### `playback:set_speed(speed)` {#set_speed}

Plays it faster or slower, 0.25 to 4 (held to that). Its sound plays only at speed 1.

| Parameter | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `speed` | `number?` | The new speed; `nil` is 1. |

**Returns** `boolean`: `false` when it has ended.

### `playback:volume()` {#volume}

Its sound's volume, 0 to 1; `nil` once it has ended.

**Returns** `number?`

### `playback:set_volume(volume)` {#set_volume}

Changes its sound's volume, 0 to 1 (held to that); its sound starts again at the new volume.

| Parameter | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `volume` | `number?` | The new volume; `nil` is 1. |

**Returns** `boolean`: `false` when it has ended.

### `playback:is_looping()` {#is_looping}

Whether it starts again when it reaches its end.

**Returns** `boolean`

### `playback:set_looping(looping)` {#set_looping}

Whether it starts again when it reaches its end.

| Parameter | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `looping` | `boolean` | Loop or not. |

**Returns** `boolean`: `false` when it has ended.

## Events

What `playback:on(event, handler)` listens for. See [Events](events.md) for how events work.

| Event | Payload | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `end` | [PlaybackEndEvent](types.md#playbackendevent) | The video ended, for any reason (`event.reason` says which). After it, the playback is gone and so is every handler on it; the screen keeps showing its last frame. |
| `frame` | [PlaybackFrameEvent](types.md#playbackframeevent) | A frame of the video was drawn: as often as the video's rate while it plays. Costs nothing while nobody listens. |

### `playback:on(event, handler, options?)` {#on}

Calls `handler` every time `event` happens to this, until the subscription is cancelled or its script unloads, or this goes away. A handler lives as long as both the script that registered it and the handle it's on. Handlers run in the order they were registered, each with the event object; what one returns means nothing. A handler that errors is logged and the rest still run; after 20 errors in a row it's cancelled. An event this class doesn't have is an error, so a typo is caught where it was made.

| Parameter | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | `Playback.Event` | The event's name. |
| `handler` | `fun(event: `[`Event`](types.md#event)`)` | Called with the event: its payload, plus `stop()`, `cancel()` and the rest of `Event`. |
| `options` (optional) | [`EventOptions`](types.md#eventoptions) | How to listen: `{ every = n }` for `tick`. |

**Returns** [`Subscription`](subscription.md): Call `:cancel()` on it to stop listening.

```lua
local show = this:play("trailer")
if show then
  show:on("end", function(event)
    log("trailer ended:", event.reason)
  end)
end
```

### `playback:once(event, handler)` {#once}

Like `playback:on`, but the handler runs only the next time the event happens, then stops listening.

| Parameter | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | `Playback.Event` | The event's name. |
| `handler` | `fun(event: `[`Event`](types.md#event)`)` | Called with the event. |

**Returns** [`Subscription`](subscription.md): Call `:cancel()` on it to stop waiting before then.
